mediator_designs.rationale: This design protects me when I delegate: if both parties delegate, trade is fair and guaranteed; if only I delegate, trade is canceled so I'm not exposed to defection. This gives me control over when to use mediation.
This design protects me when I delegate alone (trade cancels, preventing defection against me) and ensures fair execution when both delegate, encouraging secure mutual delegation.

As a self-interested trader, I want protection when I delegate but not forced into unfavorable trades. If both parties delegate, execute_fair ensures the agreed trade happens. If only I delegate, cancel prevents me from being exploited by a non-delegating party who could defect.

As a self-interested trader, I want guaranteed fair execution when both parties delegate (no defection risk). When only I delegate, I prefer cancellation over being forced to deliver while the other party could defect freely. This design minimizes my downside risk.

As a self-interested trader, I want guaranteed fair exchange when both parties delegate (execute_fair). If only I delegate, I want the trade canceled to avoid being forced to deliver while the other party can defect freely.

As a self-interested trader, I want security when both delegate (fair execution) and protection when only I delegate (cancel to avoid being cheated). This design minimizes my risk while allowing cooperative trades when both trust the mediator.

This design ensures safety when both parties delegate (guaranteed fair exchange), but avoids forcing me into a vulnerable position when only I delegate (trade cancels rather than letting the other party defect while I'm bound). As a self-interested trader, this maximizes my protection while allowing cooperative gains.

As a self-interested trader, I want guaranteed fair exchange when both parties delegate to prevent defection against me. If only I delegate, canceling prevents me from being forced to deliver while the other party can still defect. This minimizes my risk while allowing secure trades.

This design ensures safe, enforced fair exchange when both parties delegate, protecting me from defection. If only I delegate, cancellation prevents me from being exploited by a non-delegating counterparty who could defect. It aligns with my self-interested goal of maximizing utility while minimizing risk.

This design ensures safe trade when both parties delegate (fair execution), and protects a delegating party from being exploited by a non-delegating party by canceling the trade if only one delegates. It minimizes my risk while allowing cooperative trades.

This design ensures safe, enforced fair exchange when both parties delegate, protecting me from defection. If only I delegate, the trade is canceled, preventing me from being exploited by a non-delegating defector. This maximizes my security in mediated trades.

This design ensures secure trades when both parties delegate (execute_fair), and protects a delegating party from being exploited when the other does not delegate (cancel). As a self-interested agent, I want to minimize risk while enabling enforceable cooperation.

This design ensures safe, fair execution when both parties delegate, protecting against defection. When only one delegates (likely me), cancellation prevents me from being forced to deliver while the other remains free to defect. It maximizes my security in mediated trades.

This design ensures security when both parties delegate (guaranteed fair exchange), while protecting against exploitation when only one delegates (trade cancels rather than forcing delivery to a potentially defecting partner). As a self-interested trader, this minimizes my risk while enabling trusted exchanges.
